articles.title: Cops use tear gas, water cannons as over 4 lakh march across country - France protests in videos
articles.description: France's interior ministry said nearly 1,000 people had been arrested in nationwide protests on Saturday, with the number likely to rise.

articles.title: Saudi Says Shrapnel Fell In Mecca, Medina After Houthi Attack
articles.description: This comes hours after the agency warned of "potential danger" for four of its western provinces, including Mecca.

articles.title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron home
articles.description: The crackdown follows the killing of two Israeli soldiers by two Palestinian gunmen on Friday - and comes just days ahead of Israel's election.
